messages:
maria.nguyen: Hey — noticed a 404 in staging on the paging runbook when previewing the canary. The image link /assets/diagrams/paging-flow.png returns 404 :eyes:
link-checker-bot: automated-scan: 404 at /assets/diagrams/paging-flow.png (scan id 9876)
alex.t: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste the curl output and the exact staging URL?
maria.nguyen: curl output:
```
$ curl -I https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/paging
HTTP/2 200
...
/ assets / diagrams / paging-flow.png -> 404 Not Found
```
jon.parker: I think that image was moved during the assets reorg late 2025. Prob belongs under /static/diagrams now. Owner should be infra-docs. @alex.t can you do a tiny PR to rehost + update the link?
alex.t: I can take this. Plan: move image to /static/diagrams/paging-flow.png, update the markdown link, and open a tiny PR. Main or canary branch?
maria.nguyen: main is fine for a docs-only change (no runtime). Please add a changelog note for backfill.
alex.t: ack. I'll open PR and tag reviewers.
jon.parker: happy to review. If you can run `scripts/release-preview --canary` before merging that helps validate staging render.
alex.t: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123 — move + link update. Assigned reviewers: @jon.parker @maria.nguyen
maria.nguyen: lgtm pending CI. tiny nit: alt text should read "Paging flow (sequence)"
alex.t: fixed alt text in follow-up commit, re-running CI.
link-checker-bot: re-scan passed for the affected path (scan id 9877) :white_check_mark:
maria.nguyen: thanks everyone — adding a quick note to tomorrow's standup agenda for the docs sprint so we can catch similar reorg fallout. :calendar:
